VlocityDataPackData.Name: DR-Load-ClientProfileLoad
VlocityDataPackData.Description: Upserts Account (PersonAccount/Household) and one or more FinancialAccount__c records from the ClientOnboarding OmniScript. Uses External IDs for idempotent upsert — safe to retry on failure without creating duplicates.

fieldMappings.comment: AnnualRevenue repurposed as annual income on PersonAccount
Resolved at IP level via DataRaptor Transform or static CMDT lookup

outputParameters.name: newAccountId
outputParameters.description: Salesforce Id of the upserted Account — passed to child FinancialAccount__c records

Objects.comment: Creates one FinancialAccount__c per selected account type. iterateOver causes the DR to loop over the multiselect array.

fieldMappings.comment: Current value from AccountTypesRequested multiselect (CHECKING, SAVINGS, etc.)
Generated upstream in IP as {accountId}-{accountType} to ensure uniqueness per type

InputParameters.name: PersonalInfo
InputParameters.description: Flattened personal info from OmniScript Step 1 (FirstName, LastName, Email, etc.)

InputParameters.name: EmploymentInfo
InputParameters.description: Employment and income data from OmniScript Step 2

InputParameters.name: FinancialInfo
InputParameters.description: Financial profile from OmniScript Step 3 (AccountTypesRequested, InitialDepositAmount)

InputParameters.name: OnboardingResult
InputParameters.description: Results from ClientOnboardingIP: kycPassed, creditScore, etc.

ErrorHandling.comment: stopOnError:true means if Account upsert fails, FinancialAccount__c records are not attempted. rollbackOnError:false because DataRaptor Load does not support DML rollback — error handling/compensation must be in the IP.

interviewNotes.upsertVsInsert: Operation is Upsert on Account (using Id if provided, create otherwise) and Upsert on FinancialAccount__c using ExternalAccountId__c. This makes the entire onboarding flow idempotent — if the OmniScript is resubmitted (e.g., user hits browser back), no duplicate records are created.
interviewNotes.iterateOver: The iterateOver property on FinancialAccount__c causes the DR to loop over the AccountTypesRequested array. If the user selected [CHECKING, SAVINGS, INVESTMENT], the DR creates 3 FinancialAccount__c records in a single load operation — no Apex loop needed.
interviewNotes.parentIdChain: The Account upsert returns the new Account Id via outputParameter:newAccountId. The FinancialAccount__c mappings reference it as parentIdSource:outputParameter:newAccountId and write it to Account__c. This is the DataRaptor parent-child linking pattern.
interviewNotes.recordTypeId: PersonAccount RecordTypeId cannot be hardcoded — it differs per org. The IP resolves it via a prior DataRaptor Extract querying RecordType where DeveloperName = 'PersonAccount' and passes it as input. Alternatively, store in Custom Metadata for portability.
interviewNotes.errorHandlingNote: DataRaptor Load does not support atomic DML rollback across parent-child. If FinancialAccount__c fails after Account succeeds, the Account remains. The IP handles compensation by deleting the orphaned Account if child load fails.
interviewNotes.flsNote: DataRaptor Load respects FLS by default in OmniStudio runtime — fields the running user cannot write are silently skipped. Add field-level permission validation in IP before calling this DR if strict enforcement is needed.
